issues.description: Task "Aufgabe 10" in the problem statement asks for the IDs of all Radwege that lead to Gemeinden in Oberfranken or Unterfranken, but the reference solution selects Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.name (the radweg name) instead of an identifier column. This mismatch between the requested attribute (an ID) and the returned attribute (a name) will confuse students about which column to return and may make automated checks fail or disagree with the expected output.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution (and the template example) so the query returns the radweg identifier column rather than the name. For example, replace SELECT Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.name with SELECT Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.radweg_id (or SELECT Radweg.id if the schema uses Radweg.id). Keep the existing join condition (Gemeinde.schluessel = Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.gemeindeschluessel) and the regierungsbezirk filter, and do not add DISTINCT (the task explicitly says duplicates should not be removed). Also update the template/teacher example so students see the correct target column to return.
